name: PPIS Insurance
what_they_do: Independent insurance agency (Pollution and Property Insurance Specialists) writing personal and commercial lines across New Jersey. Personal side is auto, home, renters and umbrella; commercial side covers general liability, commercial property, commercial vehicle, workers' compensation and storage-tank liability, which appears to be a specialism. The site markets itself on quoting multiple carriers for NJ residents and small businesses.
customers: New Jersey homeowners, renters and drivers, plus small and mid-size businesses - especially those with fuel-storage or environmental exposure, given the storage-tank liability page.

size_signals.signal: Single office at 501 Adams Lane Suite 2, one phone and one fax line; staff described only as 'our agents' with no named producers
Six commercial coverage lines each with their own page (property, vehicle, general liability, workers comp, storage tank)

listing.platform: Google (as reported by a third-party directory)
listing.reviews: 3 (review text looks unrelated to insurance, so treat with caution)

website_review.primary_cta: 'GET A QUOTE' buttons on the auto/home and commercial sections, plus a phone number in the footer
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Contact Form 7 quote request (name, e-mail, telephone, message); no carrier-comparison or instant quote, no appointment slot
website_review.trust_signals: Named specialty, coverage-by-coverage pages, address, phone, fax and hours; no carrier logos, no testimonials, no team photos
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright reads 2026 but no meta description; on 390px the form inputs overflow the right edge of the viewport; no photos of staff or office
website_review.search_basics: Home title is 'Home - PPIS Insurance' - no service, no town, no description; coverage pages exist per line of business; JSON-LD is a Yoast WebPage/Organization graph but the @id URLs are still http:// and there is no LocalBusiness with hours
top_issues: Title 'Home - PPIS Insurance' with no meta description at all
No click-to-call tel: link anywhere - the phone is plain text
No hours, service area or price signal in schema, and JSON-LD URLs still use http://
Quote request is a generic contact form, not a coverage-aware quote intake

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: robots.txt is a default allow-all with crawl-delay 1 and no Disallow; no convincing Google Business Profile rating (the only '5.0 from 3' listing shows unrelated review text). Answerable: address, phone, fax and hours are readable text on the contact page, but the home page has no description, no schema LocalBusiness/hours, and no premium or price-range information. Bookable: a labelled Contact Form 7 form with no CAPTCHA, but it collects only name/e-mail/phone/message, so an agent cannot get a quote or bind a policy - everything ends in a human callback.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Turn the generic contact form into a coverage-aware quote intake (line of business, property/vehicle details, effective date) that pre-fills carrier submissions and replies instantly
top_opportunities.evidence: Only form on the site is Contact Form 7 with name, e-mail, telephone and message; every 'GET A QUOTE' button leads there

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix local search basics: descriptive page titles, meta description, LocalBusiness schema with hours and area served, and click-to-call on mobile
top_opportunities.evidence: document.title is 'Home - PPIS Insurance', description is null, JSON-LD has no LocalBusiness/hours and uses http:// @ids, and there are zero tel: links

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add a simple annual-renewal reminder and cross-sell follow-up sequence (auto to home to umbrella; business to workers comp)
top_opportunities.evidence: Agency sells six commercial lines plus personal lines but the site offers no client portal, reminders or follow-up mechanism - only a one-off contact form

scores.reasons: Gap: no meta description, no tel links, no LocalBusiness schema, and quote requests are a plain contact form. Ability to pay: small independent agency earning commissions, so moderate and tied to policy volume. Ease: WordPress with Contact Form 7, so quote intake plus schema is a short project. Evidence: opened home and contact pages, read robots.txt and JSON-LD, checked the 390px form layout; review evidence is weak.
